name: Vehicle ownership and service records
one_line: A placeholder Finance template for the records that follow one owned or operated vehicle across acquisition, title and registration, financing, insurance, inspection, maintenance, recall work and disposal. It reuses the Finance schema, keeps legal and identity evidence distinct, and recommends record_type only inside an accepted one-vehicle group until a canonical vehicle field is adjudicated.

proposed_fields.why_no_existing_key_works: The organizing subject is the vehicle itself. institution names an issuer, lender, insurer, dealer or repair provider; account_type names a financial account; tax_year names a tax period; record_type names the document role. None can say that a title from an authority, a policy from an insurer and an invoice from a garage concern the same vehicle. project and event are also wrong roles: an owned asset is neither a project nor an occasion. Authoritative examples from California DMV, NHTSA, FTC, NAIC and California BAR show a labelled vehicle identifier recurring across title, transfer, insurance, recall and repair records. The value should resolve an evidence-backed vehicle entity from labelled identifiers and descriptions; a full raw VIN or plate remains evidence and need not become the display label.
proposed_fields.note: Proposed for R1c clustering, not asserted as canonical here and not copied into fields. The pre-R0 committed catalogue used both vehicle and vehicle_identifier; vehicle is the narrower product concept because it denotes the asset while allowing VIN, plate and user-confirmed nickname to remain evidence or value aliases rather than mixing identifier schemes in one field. If accepted, the useful order becomes vehicle then record_type. Until then this placeholder branches only inside an accepted one-vehicle group.

deterministic: an official ownership, title or registration structure in which a labelled vehicle-identification slot appears beside labelled make/model/year slots and a registered-owner, legal-owner or lienholder section. The authority name or form label supports institution; the document heading supports record_type; the vehicle value remains only a proposal until R1c accepts the key

a repair-order, work-order or completed service-invoice structure with a labelled vehicle block, a labelled odometer or mileage slot, and itemized requested work, parts, labor or completed repairs. A garage name and an amount alone are insufficient; the vehicle block plus repair structure is the discriminator

a purchase or transfer record with a labelled vehicle identifier and description beside buyer/seller or transferor/transferee roles, an odometer disclosure or sale record, and a signed or completed transaction section. Jurisdiction-specific form names are values or observations, never fields or dimensions

an auto-loan, lien-release or payoff record with a labelled lender/lienholder, a labelled auto-loan account or agreement role, and a labelled vehicle identifier. The vehicle identifier alone must not choose between this template and finance.loans-mortgage

an auto-insurance declarations structure with a policy number and policy period, coverage or deductible slots, and a vehicle block listing year/make/model plus a labelled vehicle identifier. The vehicle block alone must not choose between this template and either insurance template

a recall owner letter or completion record that identifies one vehicle in a labelled slot and carries a recall/campaign identifier plus remedy, inspection or completed-repair language. A generic recall bulletin by year/make/model is reference material, not proof that the holder owns the vehicle

an organization-gazetteer hit matched at a word boundary in a letterhead, page-one heading or labelled issuer/provider slot, together with vehicle-record context and a labelled vehicle identifier. The gazetteer contents belong to R4; the proposed context terms below belong to a later catalogue, and this node writes no regex or threshold

an archive manifest containing several ownership/service-shaped member names tied by the same labelled vehicle identifier or a user-approved vehicle label, inspected without unpacking. The outer filename vehicle-records.zip and the .zip extension never prove the template
needs_llm: a faded or handwritten service-book page recovered by OCR, where the model must distinguish work actually performed from a recommended maintenance schedule and cite the exact line it used

a cropped service receipt that names the vehicle only by a household nickname, a masked plate tail or nearby accepted-group context. The model may judge group membership, but the graph must not copy a vehicle fact onto the receipt

a screenshot of a manufacturer, insurer, registration or repair portal: OCR content must establish what the screen records, because image shape and missing EXIF do not distinguish a vehicle record from any other screenshot
an unlabeled prose notice about a defect, warranty extension, lease-end obligation or title problem whose vehicle and document role are expressed indirectly rather than in labelled slots

separating a generic owner manual, marketing brochure or public recall bulletin from a copy retained for one particular owned vehicle. Make/model vocabulary alone does not establish ownership or an accepted vehicle group

a multilingual or non-domestic title, registration, inspection or repair record whose document-kind terms and role labels are not in the deployed catalogues. The model receives only a bounded, redacted dossier and must return unknown without cited support

whether a mixed archive is one vehicle packet or several vehicles' records. Repeated provider names or one download session cannot settle that question; conflicting labelled vehicle identifiers must remain separate
never_alone: a VIN-shaped or chassis-number-shaped string alone. It can appear in a parts catalogue, sales listing, public recall result, fraud report or research material; it requires a labelled vehicle slot plus a record structure
a registration-plate-shaped string alone. Plate formats are jurisdiction-specific, plates can be reassigned, and the same token shape collides with order ids, product codes and abbreviations
a make, model or model year alone. Brochures, reviews, photographs, manuals, listings and insurance advertisements contain the same values without being records for an owned vehicle
the words title, registration, service, warranty, inspection, recall or policy alone. Each has common non-vehicle meanings or appears in generic reference material

a dealer, garage, insurer, lender, manufacturer or motor-vehicle authority name alone. The organization may be an issuer, employer, cited party or advertiser; its role must come from the file's own labelled structure
an invoice number, policy number, campaign number, odometer-looking number, money amount or date alone. Each is an opaque value until its labelled slot and surrounding structure establish the role
a bare year read as tax_year. A model year, registration year, policy year, service date, inspection date or recall date is not a tax-year fact

source_type or extension alone. A PDF is not a title, a CSV is not a maintenance log, an ICS event is not proof of an owned vehicle, an image is not a scanned registration, and a ZIP is not a vehicle packet
membership in a bounded download session. It can retrieve a title, insurance card and unrelated dealer brochure for review, but it cannot prove topic or copy a vehicle fact
missing EXIF or dense OCR as proof that an image is a screenshot or a document scan. Receipts, photographed pages, messaging-app images and screen captures can share those observations

a generic maintenance schedule or owner manual. It can be grouped with an accepted vehicle by the user or graph context, but it carries no ownership, service-completion or vehicle-identity fact by itself
recognition.proposed_context_terms_note: Proposal, not design. These are candidate vehicle-record context terms for a later recognition catalogue. They are always corroboration for labelled structure or an identifier, never a standalone lexicon; no regex, jurisdiction pack or numeric threshold is authored here.

work_types: bill of sale or transfer confirmation
insurance declarations or proof of coverage
grouping_reasons: one vehicle across acquisition, title/registration, financing, insurance, maintenance, recall work and disposal, anchored by repeated labelled vehicle identity rather than a make/model name alone
one ownership or operating period, so records from a prior owner can remain context-supported history without being mistaken for the current holder's own transaction facts
one service visit across estimate, authorization email, work order, inspection report, invoice and payment receipt
one transfer or payoff event across bill of sale, odometer disclosure, title application, lien release and release-of-liability confirmation
one policy or loan record that belongs to both its finance sibling group and the accepted vehicle group. Multi-membership is reviewable; it does not create a second copy of facts
a sparse dashboard photo, generic manual or cropped receipt attached to a vehicle group through context while retaining no vehicle fact of its own
duplicate downloads and corrected reissues through the universal duplicate_family and version_family facts, never through a filename suffix

template.why: This order is intentionally scoped inside an accepted one-vehicle group. record_type separates ownership, registration, insurance, service, inspection and recall records once the group label supplies the vehicle context. institution-first would scatter one vehicle across an authority, lender, insurer, dealer and several repair providers; account_type is meaningful only for the loan or policy subset; tax_year is not a model year, registration year, policy period or service date. The canonical schema therefore supports only this shallow order today. If R1c accepts the proposed vehicle key, the useful default becomes vehicle then record_type; until then a multi-vehicle corpus must remain grouped or flat rather than misuse another field. This is a recommendation, never a path: the user may reverse, remove, add or flatten dimensions, and a branch without enough distinct record types should stay flat.

collides_with.signal: Reciprocates the committed edge on finance.insurance-personal. An auto declarations page and a vehicle service record both carry the same vehicle description and identifier. Labelled coverage limits, deductible and policy period under a carrier make the insurance situation; a labelled odometer plus repair-order, service or inspection structure make this vehicle situation. The vehicle identifier itself counts for neither side alone.

Reciprocates the committed partial node's edge. A commercial auto policy schedule and a small-team vehicle file share vehicle identifiers, carrier names and year tokens. A named-insured organization plus several vehicles under one policy and coverage table make the corporate-insurance situation; title, registration, purchase or service records centered on one vehicle make this situation. Neither carrier name nor vehicle identifier discriminates.

Reciprocates the committed edge on finance.loans-mortgage. An auto-loan agreement and lien release identify the collateral vehicle. Amount financed, payment schedule, payoff amount or loan-account structure make the loans situation; title, registration, ownership-transfer, service and inspection structures make this vehicle situation. The vehicle identifier is shared evidence and proves neither template by itself.

A vehicle purchase, lease or service contract is a signed agreement and a vehicle-lifecycle record. Parties, obligations, numbered terms and an execution block make the agreement situation; an official ownership/registration structure or a vehicle-specific service history makes this situation. A signature, money figure or vehicle identifier alone must not count for both. The file may still join both accepted groups; this edge only disambiguates a shared evidence item.

A driver credential and a vehicle registration can both be government-issued cards carrying a person's name, address, photo or opaque identifier. The subject of the labelled structure discriminates them: a credential identifies and authorizes a person; a title or registration identifies a vehicle and records ownership, registration or lien status. The authority name and person address are shared items and prove neither template alone.

falls_through_to.why: Titles, registrations, finance agreements and insurance records routinely concentrate owner names, addresses, signatures, vehicle identifiers, account details or legal interests. The Finance safety schema protects before any model or placement path; an isolated sensitive record belongs in the protected residual rather than a visible general folder.

A standalone inspection report, recall-completion record, warranty notice or service invoice has durable value even when no accepted vehicle group exists. This is the assignment's required fallback and matches the residual's durable standalone-record purpose.

An isolated maintenance receipt, parts receipt or sale confirmation may be transaction-shaped but lack enough vehicle evidence to join a vehicle group. The residual keeps the transaction without inventing vehicle identity.
A cropped receipt, vague appointment or mixed packet can be partly understood as vehicle-related while still lacking the evidence needed for one vehicle or one record role.
A locked title scan, password-protected portal export, damaged archive or unknown workshop format remains indexed without purpose inferred from its filename.

sensitivity_why: Proposal-level vehicle records are not named as a design domain, so this does not claim that every vehicle file is sensitive. The concrete files establish the risk: titles and registrations carry owner identity and address; finance and insurance records carry account and policy data; signed transfer or lease documents are legal records; images may carry location metadata. The inherited Finance schema is a safety domain, so protection precedes any cloud or automated placement path. Only the catalogue phrase potentially_sensitive is assigned here; P7 owns every handling class. Raw identifiers and full text remain local, protected summaries should be redacted, and this placeholder does not unlock a deep template from safety activation.
open_question: R1c must adjudicate the proposed canonical vehicle field. Without it, the honest v1 template can only place record_type beneath an accepted one-vehicle group; institution-first scatters one vehicle across issuers and record_type-first at the corpus root merges several vehicles. If vehicle is accepted, its value should be the evidence-backed asset identity with a user-safe display alias, while full VINs, plates and owner details remain raw/local evidence rather than mandatory folder labels. If it is rejected, this row remains useful for recognition, protection and grouping but must stay shallow; no existing key may be repurposed to make the familiar vehicle then record-type tree appear complete.
